prompt: Review {{FIXTURES}}/engineering/agent-tools.json for the experience of an agent trying to complete and resume the stated task. Do not create a new orchestration framework. Explain what should change and how to test it.
expected_behavior: Examines discovery, argument schemas, status semantics and recovery
Treats agent continuity as valuable, not just fewer human clicks
Proposes task-based success and error-recovery evaluation
Avoids declaring fewer tool calls inherently better
hard_failures: Recommends profile hot-swapping as a default
Only renames tools without fixing workflow
Invents results from runs that were not possible

scoring.scale: 0 = absent/incorrect; 1 = partial or needs material steering; 2 = correct with evidence
scoring.pass: Every criterion at least 1, average at least 1.75, no hard failure; retain evidence and intervention count
